scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && npm run build -w @ourworld/api && npm run build -w @ourworld/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ourworld/contracts && npm run test -w @ourworld/api && node tests/unit/color-tokens.mjs && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs && node tests/unit/profile-refs.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ourworld/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ourworld/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ourworld/globe && npm run typecheck -w @ourworld/api && npm run typecheck -w @ourworld/web
scripts.prepare:assets: node scripts/generate/sync-design.mjs && node scripts/generate/generate-openapi.mjs && npm run build -w @ourworld/contracts && npm run build -w @ourworld/globe && node scripts/generate/sync-globe.mjs
